m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: So... we meet again. Who sent you?
Dworgyn? It has been years since he worked for me. Whatever does he need?
Oh... he seeks the secrets of my monster, my greatest creation! You know, that really takes me back...
We were young, and I was just getting into the whole mad scientist thing, and Dworgyn had just graduated from Hench School.
The things we got up to! Robbing graveyards, stitching corpses, calling lightning from the sky!  Those were the days...
But I am afraid I cannot help you. My papers were stolen from my lab some time ago.
I heard rumors that they had been taken by a sorcerer named the Hoarder, but I do not know any more.
Go now, and slink back to Dworgyn with your tail between your legs.
Oh, you don't have a tail? Well... let me out of this cell, and I'll fix that...
Did Katzenstein teach you what you needed to know?
If it isn't my favorite student! What brings you here?
What's that? I sent for you? Oh, yes... of course I did! I have the very best of news for you... it's time for a new spell!
This one is a favorite of mine, and goes way back to when I was just getting started in the henchman business.
I'm going to teach you to summon Katzenstein's Monster! That's right! A fearsome construct of flesh and metal!
Before we get started, though, you must speak to Dr. Katzenstein himself! He'll tell you how to invoke his monster!
Go speak to him in Marleybone. After the unfortunate events you're no doubt aware of, he's in the custody of Scotland Yard.
Go speak to Dr. Katzenstein in Marleybone. He's being held in a cell in Scotland Yard. Return here when you're done with him!
